objective: Run a tuck-in from first seller contact to cutover: portal intake, pre-LOI screen on the target's own data, diligence pack, and unit and owner migration into appropriate PMS system.

risks.risk: Deal volume rises faster than the team can absorb it
risks.mitigation: Dedicated tuck-in team and org design run alongside the tool

risks.risk: The tiger team model is unproven and this is the pilot
risks.mitigation: Small named group, fixed cadence, clear goals. Learn and improve the model from it

risks.risk: Timelines for MVP end of Oct'26 are veryy aggressive
risks.mitigation: Discuss in every checkin meeting to undersand how far we are and descope as needed

dependencies.need: Seller portal intake and target data at pre-LOI
Dedicated tuck-in team to run it every day

milestones.title: Working automation tool for Ryan and team to pilot
Pre-LOI screen and seller portal live
Diligence pack, then unit and owner migration into Track
Release the MVP version for broader use

name: Security Program
objective: The objectives of this security program are to honor the expectations of our employees, owners, and guests to protect the PII data they share with us to do business. This is an unspoken covenant between Awayday and those who share this data with us. This also materially matures the security program as we prepare for exit readiness.

risks.risk: Enough IT resources to execute.
risks.mitigation: Hire FTE/ augment with third parties.

risks.risk: Organizational change fatigue.
risks.mitigation: Work with biz leaders to pace.

risks.risk: 3rd party (PMS systems) capacity.
risks.mitigation: Escalate internally when needed.

dependencies.need: Data classification for DLP.
Budget for FTE and consultants.
Educate ELT more on the why of security

milestones.title: Security Awareness Training – New Hires & Continuous For Employees
PMS Security Architecture – Internal & Vendor Audits with Remediation Plans
Acquisition Security Factory – Process to secure prior to integration. Liquid Life to start.
Data Loss Prevention (DLP) - Classify data, monitor, and prevent PII exfiltration.
Conditional Access Policy Enhancements – Policies which determine who and what devices can login from what locations.

name: Owner Relations
aopObjective: Frontier tech and AI in every team's hands
objective: Write each owner's monthly revenue explanation before they ask, answer revenue questions in the ticket queue, respond quickly to admin requests, and score churn risk 90 days out with the reason and the intervention. The next moat-building area behind guest relations.
metric: Owner unit churn, and properties per FTE in OR

risks.risk: Rolls out before shops are change-ready and the value is not captured
risks.mitigation: Only roll out in shops that have already delivered value on Conduit

risks.risk: Ticket mix does not match the churn driver: 35% maintenance, 2% revenue
risks.mitigation: Remove the maintenance and admin burden so time goes to revenue

risks.risk: Use cases are not yet scoped
risks.mitigation: Scope the specific use cases with Ops before committing

dependencies.need: Business alignment and cross functional champions

milestones.title: Specific use cases scoped with the Product Owner
Roll out in change-ready shops that have delivered on Conduit
Properties per FTE at 1 : 140 where rolled out

name: Onboarding experience
objective:
The new owner onboarding process is highly variable cross brands, leading to ~7% of new units onboarded within the last 12 months to churn within 6 months of joining the program
The cost of a bringing on a new unit is high (>$6k / unit), and the potential lifetime value of a unit is high (>$50k EBITDA), so retaining new owners is mission critical to the business

risks.risk: Support team owns onboarding process reducing ownership from in field teams
risks.mitigation: Supporting team does only back-end administration support and develop automation tools

risks.risk: Onboarding challenges are symptoms of broader disfunction
risks.mitigation: Work on identifying root cause issue for brands with high 6-month churn and work with team to improve

risks.risk: Lack of full data to understand opportunities
risks.mitigation: Refine and rollout GBV churn SOP

dependencies.need: Onboarding tracking tool development
Regional alignment on onboarding approach

milestones.title: Finalize the onboarding tracking tool and refine with pilot program
Identify core brands with onboarding challenges and assess how to best support
Run new onboarding support system with current SupportCo onboarding teams; provide data analytics upwards to BPs and RVPs
Develop and rollout regional support model in collaboration with RVPs
